overview: Convergent segregated mixed-methods systematic review: a budget strand and a practice-and-views strand, each with its own primary outcome, integrated in a joint display for the board.
population: Budget strand: populations served by community pharmacies with extended opening in high-income health systems. Practice strand: pharmacists, owners, commissioners, clinicians and members of the public with experience of extended opening.
exposure: Extended weekday evening or Sunday opening of community pharmacies compared with usual hours.
procedures: Search of four bibliographic sources, commissioning papers and pharmacy body reports from 2005; dual screening of 20 percent; separate extraction forms for each strand; budget figures re-priced to 2026 with the authority's out-of-hours unit costs once data governance approves; thematic synthesis of practice findings; joint display built after both strands are complete.

outcomes.name: Net budget impact for the payer (budget strand)
outcomes.measure: Scheme cost minus valued offsets per year, re-expressed in 2026 prices and shown across counterfactual assumptions for each study
outcomes.timing: Per year, up to three years
outcomes.why: The board's budget question, without a pooled figure (claim c3).

outcomes.name: How extended hours work in practice (practice strand)
outcomes.measure: Synthesised findings on access, staffing, safety and displacement, each with a GRADE-CERQual confidence rating
outcomes.why: The board's second question; a different kind of evidence with its own primary outcome.

outcomes.name: Avoided contacts per 1,000 late consultations
outcomes.measure: Out-of-hours GP contacts and emergency attendances avoided, as reported or estimated

outcomes.name: Reporting completeness of budget studies
outcomes.measure: Share of budget studies reporting perspective, price year, currency, horizon and offsets
outcomes.why: Shows how far each estimate can be trusted.

outcomes.name: Displacement of demand
outcomes.measure: Evidence that daytime pharmacy or GP use fell as late use rose
outcomes.why: Savings are illusory if demand only moves.

outcomes.name: Staffing premium for late shifts
outcomes.measure: Locum and security costs above the supplement

feasibility: One analyst for six months with a second reviewer for 20 percent of screening and all budget extraction; re-pricing takes about two weeks once approved.
biasMitigation: Funding source of each study extracted and shown in the joint display
Budget figures re-priced by a second analyst

biasFlags.label: Sponsorship by pharmacy bodies
biasFlags.note: Shown for every study in the joint display.

biasFlags.label: Counterfactual assumptions
biasFlags.note: Every budget figure is shown across its assumptions.

biasFlags.label: Integration forcing agreement
biasFlags.note: Discordance between strands is reported, not resolved away.

flags: Two primary outcomes, one per strand, by design; they are never combined into one number
parsimony.simplestPath: Two strands, one primary outcome each, one joint display.

theoreticalFramework: JBI convergent segregated approach to mixed-methods systematic reviews.
summary: Two-strand review with one primary outcome per strand, a process and a balancing outcome, and a joint display.
